description: The line plot illustrates the similarity across different layers for four language combinations: en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale with a plotted data range from 1 to 23, displaying numeric tick marks at intervals of 2 from 0 to 22. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The "en&en" data is represented by a solid red line without markers. It begins at layer 1 with a similarity of approximately 0.07, rises to a distinct peak of roughly 0.26 at layer 6, drops to about 0.16 at layer 7, forms a broader, lower peak near 0.18 around layers 11 and 12, declines to a low of approximately 0.08 at layer 20, and then spikes sharply to end at roughly 0.43 at layer 23. The "en&es" data is shown as a solid blue line without markers. It starts at approximately 0.06 at layer 1, peaks at roughly 0.24 at layer 6, drops to about 0.15 at layer 7, reaches a secondary peak near 0.17 at layer 12, declines to roughly 0.05 at layer 20, and spikes to end at approximately 0.27 at layer 23. The "en&el" data is depicted by a solid green line without markers. It begins at roughly 0.04 at layer 1, peaks at approximately 0.15 at layer 6, drops to about 0.10 at layer 7, rises to a secondary peak near 0.15 at layer 12, declines to a low of roughly 0.04 at layer 20, and spikes to end at approximately 0.30 at layer 23. Finally, the "en&bn" data is represented by a solid purple line without markers. It starts at approximately 0.03 at layer 1, peaks at roughly 0.14 at layer 6, drops to about 0.09 at layer 7, reaches a secondary peak near 0.14 at layer 12, declines to roughly 0.05 at layer 20, and spikes to end at approximately 0.29 at layer 23.
